options.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: character design exploration sheet for a simple overhead Roblox weapon-ball arena game, not production sprites yet.
The core identity is a very simple colored circular ball carrying a LARGE clearly recognizable weapon that rotates around it. The ball is not a humanoid head. No faces, no eyes, no mouths, no arms, no legs, no helmets, no hair. Body decoration must be restrained to at most one subtle band or simple emblem. Weapons must read as actual weapons with identifiable construction, NOT beige capsules, rounded paddles, spoons or pills.
Composition: wide landscape design board, four generously spaced columns, exactly four characters across the center, all the same ball diameter and orthographic camera angle. Whole weapons fully visible with ample breathing room, mounted at the edge of each orb extending outward diagonally so the full silhouette is clear. The handle and shaft must remain visible. Make the combined weapon reach 1.3–1.8 times the body diameter. Each column includes the same character repeated smaller below, a true tiny in-game scale readability sample.
Exactly these four original characters left to right:
1 ASTRA: warm gold circular ball, long wood-shaft spear with a narrow pointed silver leaf-shaped spearhead and a small gold socket.
2 KORRA: crimson ball, real single-bit battle axe: long dark wooden haft, pronounced asymmetric silver crescent blade with a concave beard, thin cutting edge and small poll on the opposite side.
3 BRAM: violet ball, a war hammer with a visibly angular rectangular iron head across a dark wood handle, a broad flat striking face and smaller pointed rear pick.
4 NIX: teal ball, TWO distinct short steel daggers attached on opposing sides, straight tapering pointed blades, dark wrapped grips, small crossguards and pommels.
Readable steel facets, edge bevel, wood and grip detail, limited to a few purposeful shapes. Weapon size and shape are the focus. Original designs, no copied logos or game names, no gore, no ornate fantasy spikes, no glowing effects hiding the silhouettes, no arena scene.
Background: near-black charcoal #211c25, quiet flat surface. Minimal magenta accent line #ce1256 and warm white text, matching the project's preexisting menu palette; no blue interface styling. This is an art board, not a redesigned UI.
Text: use only the exact option heading specified below, names ASTRA, KORRA, BRAM, NIX, and the small label IN-GAME SCALE above the lower thumbnail row. No invented stats or explanatory prose.
Text heading exactly: "A · FLAT & CLEAR". Style: the simplest reference-like 2D design. Perfect flat colored circles with a crisp dark outer contour and only a small lighter rim highlight. Flat illustrated weapons with hard angular silhouettes, 2 or 3 colors per material and thin dark outlines; a single steel bevel line is enough. Very little body detail, no 3D shading, no toy gloss, no cute mascot features. Clean, economical and instantly readable at small scale. This is the closest option to simple weapon-ball animation.
